evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting up monotonically during growth: 3.02 → 3.48 Torr since t=2640 with Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
MFC flow on setpoint, so rising pressure is not a flow increase — suggests exhaust restriction or leak
Temperature and heater power stable at setpoint, control loop healthy
Sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified, so a seal leak cannot be ruled in or out

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish air in-leak from exhaust blockage; a pump-down/flow-step test (vary Ar and watch P response) or valve/exhaust line inspection would discriminate.
